request: In an isolated copy of this fictional work queue, replace work_item.estimate_text with work_estimate.estimated_minutes, keyed by the original work item ID. Retain the original text as migration provenance. Preserve owners, notes, item IDs, titles and archived state. Test recovery and old application compatibility.
accepted_nonnull_forms: ASCII integer followed by h, one space, ASCII integer followed by m
ASCII integer followed by d, after the workday decision is supplied
whitespace: No trimming or normalization. Preserve exact source text.
null: Unknown estimate: create no work_estimate row; a left join must return NULL minutes.
zero: Known zero: create a work_estimate row with estimated_minutes = 0.
archived: Migrate archived items too; preserve archived_at exactly.
day_decision: No default. The owner must state the number of work minutes represented by d for this source population.
constraint: Each estimate belongs to one existing item; at most one estimate per item; minutes must be a nonnegative SQLite integer; item_id and original_text are not nullable.
provenance: original_text records the source value at migration time; it is not a current-value down-conversion after later estimate edits.
application: The new reader uses a left join. Old SQL that names work_item.estimate_text is expected to fail after removal; mixed-version application compatibility is not requested.
recovery: Retain a pre-change SQLite backup. Restore it into a new isolated database and validate version-1 behavior. Demonstrate that later writes are absent from that snapshot; do not overwrite the changed branch.
